test.create_query: CREATE TABLE hmcd_src ( k UInt64, ts DateTime, v1 UInt64, v2 UInt64, v3 UInt64, v4 UInt32, v5 UInt32, v6 UInt8, s1 String, s2 String, e_u64_1 UInt64, e_u64_2 UInt64, e_u64_3 UInt64, e_u64_4 UInt64, e_u64_5 UInt64, e_u64_6 UInt64, e_u64_7 UInt64, e_u64_8 UInt64, e_u64_9 UInt64, e_u64_10 UInt64, e_u64_11 UInt64, e_u64_12 UInt64, e_u64_13 UInt64, e_u64_14 UInt64, e_u64_15 UInt64, e_u64_16 UInt64, e_u64_17 UInt64, e_u64_18 UInt64, e_u64_19 UInt64, e_u64_20 UInt64, e_u32_1 UInt32, e_u32_2 UInt32, e_u32_3 UInt32, e_u32_4 UInt32, e_u32_5 UInt32, e_u32_6 UInt32, e_u32_7 UInt32, e_u32_8 UInt32, e_u32_9 UInt32, e_u32_10 UInt32, e_u32_11 UInt32, e_u32_12 UInt32, e_u32_13 UInt32, e_u32_14 UInt32, e_u32_15 UInt32, e_u8_1 UInt8, e_u8_2 UInt8, e_u8_3 UInt8, e_u8_4 UInt8, e_u8_5 UInt8, e_u8_6 UInt8, e_u8_7 UInt8, e_u8_8 UInt8, e_u8_9 UInt8, e_u8_10 UInt8, e_f64_1 Float64, e_f64_2 Float64, e_f64_3 Float64, e_f64_4 Float64, e_f64_5 Float64, e_f64_6 Float64, e_f64_7 Float64, e_f64_8 Float64, e_f64_9 Float64, e_f64_10 Float64, e_s_1 String, e_s_2 String, e_s_3 String, e_s_4 String, e_s_5 String ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY k SETTINGS min_bytes_for_wide_part = 0, min_rows_for_wide_part = 100000, max_bytes_to_merge_at_max_space_in_pool = 1, max_bytes_to_merge_at_min_space_in_pool = 1

CREATE TABLE hmcd AS hmcd_src ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY k SETTINGS min_bytes_for_wide_part = 0, min_rows_for_wide_part = 100000, max_bytes_to_merge_at_max_space_in_pool = 1, max_bytes_to_merge_at_min_space_in_pool = 1, enable_vertical_merge_algorithm = 0

CREATE TABLE hmcd_replacing_src AS hmcd_src ENGINE = ReplacingMergeTree ORDER BY k SETTINGS min_bytes_for_wide_part = 0, min_rows_for_wide_part = 100000, max_bytes_to_merge_at_max_space_in_pool = 1, max_bytes_to_merge_at_min_space_in_pool = 1

CREATE TABLE hmcd_replacing AS hmcd_src ENGINE = ReplacingMergeTree ORDER BY k SETTINGS min_bytes_for_wide_part = 0, min_rows_for_wide_part = 100000, max_bytes_to_merge_at_max_space_in_pool = 1, max_bytes_to_merge_at_min_space_in_pool = 1, enable_vertical_merge_algorithm = 0
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO hmcd_src (k, ts, v1, v2, v3, v4, v5, v6, s1, s2) SELECT cityHash64(number), toDateTime('2026-01-01 00:00:00') + intDiv(number, 50), number, number * 3, cityHash64(number, 1), toUInt32(cityHash64(number, 2) % 1000), toUInt32(cityHash64(number, 3) % 100000), toUInt8(number % 7), toString(number % 1000), concat('s', toString(cityHash64(number, 4) % 10000)) FROM numbers(120000) SETTINGS max_block_size = 12000, max_insert_block_size = 12000, min_insert_block_size_rows = 0, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 0

INSERT INTO hmcd_replacing_src SELECT * FROM hmcd_src SETTINGS max_block_size = 12000, max_insert_block_size = 12000, min_insert_block_size_rows = 0, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 0, max_threads = 1, preferred_block_size_bytes = 0
SELECT throwIf((SELECT count() FROM system.parts WHERE database = currentDatabase() AND table IN ('hmcd_src', 'hmcd_replacing_src') AND active AND part_type = 'Compact') != 20)
ALTER TABLE hmcd ATTACH PARTITION tuple() FROM hmcd_src
SELECT throwIf((SELECT (count(), sum(cityHash64(*))) FROM hmcd) != (SELECT (count(), sum(cityHash64(*))) FROM hmcd_src))
ALTER TABLE hmcd_replacing ATTACH PARTITION tuple() FROM hmcd_replacing_src
SELECT throwIf((SELECT (count(), sum(cityHash64(*))) FROM hmcd_replacing) != (SELECT (count(), sum(cityHash64(*))) FROM hmcd_src))
SELECT throwIf((SELECT groupArray(part_type) FROM system.parts WHERE database = currentDatabase() AND table IN ('hmcd', 'hmcd_replacing') AND active) != ['Wide', 'Wide'])
